greeting: Hold it! That crate needs inspection!
Carl's the name, crate inspection's the game!
Everything gets checked! No exceptions! Rules are RULES!
Back again? Bringing more crates? I'll inspect 'em!
Welcome to the docks! Where every box tells a story!
New face! You with a shipment? Paperwork in order?
I inspect EVERYTHING. Parcels, crates, suspicious barrels. ESPECIALLY barrels.
The port depends on proper inspection! I am that inspector!
dialog.inspection_process: Visual check! Weight check! Knock test! Smell test! If it passes, it moves!
dialog.crate_stories: Found a LIVE CAT in a crate once. Shipping label said 'delicate glassware.' Close enough!
dialog.contraband_confiscated: Caught smugglers last month! Hiding gems in FISH GUTS! Clever. Gross. But clever.
dialog.barrel_prejudice: Barrels. Can't trust 'em. Roll around. Hide things. Barrelgobs LIVE in 'em. Suspicious containers!
rumor: Heard there's a barrel in Dustbelt that walks. Confirmed my suspicions about barrels!
Tide's port gets shipments from EVERY zone. Even Frost. Ice-packed everything.
Mire's dockmaster takes BRIBES. Not me! I'm HONEST!
Aetherreach ships by balloon. No crates. Just... bags. Weird.
dialog.paperwork_love: I love paperwork. Forms. Stamps. SIGNATURES. The system WORKS!
farewell: Move along! Nothing to see! Except properly inspected goods!
Keep your papers in order! Or face the CONSEQUENCES!
Come back with MORE crates! I LIVE for this!
dialog.time_dawn: Early inspection! First shipment of the day!
dialog.time_noon: Peak cargo! So many crates! SO HAPPY!

party_reactions.kade: Someone has to do it. Thanks for keeping things honest.
party_reactions.twist: You check BOXES?! All DAY?! That's... a lot of boxes!
party_reactions.korr: Honest work. The port runs on trust.
party_reactions.renna: Do you use detection magic? Or just... knocking?
party_reactions.suresh: Diligence in small things builds integrity.
party_reactions.sova: I'd get bored. Fast. But someone has to do it.
party_reactions.grit: Quartermaster would love you. Everything accounted for.
party_reactions.ashka: Checking boxes. Not fighting. Different life.
party_reactions.senna: Good cover. No one suspects the inspector.
party_reactions.callum: You really like your job, don't you? That's nice!

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Regular shipper! I recognize your goods!
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! Your crates get PRIORITY inspection!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! Exempt from random checks! That's TRUST!
